description: Use this when the user wants a body pose the library doesn't have (try search_poses first). Describe the pose in words, head to toe (up to 600 characters), or pass based_on with a library pose's handle and say what to change ("the left arm raised higher"). If library poses already look like the request, they come back first and no design starts: use one, or call again with confirm: true to design anyway. A design takes about 3-6 minutes: poll check_pose_design with the returned design_id every 20-30 seconds; when it is done, use the new @handle like any pose ("@barry in @<new_handle>"). 100 credits, charged only when the pose is made: a refused or failed design is free. Paid plans, up to 20 designs a day. Every pose must be one a real body can do: impossible poses, contortion, sex positions, minors, real people and violence are refused with the reason and, when there is one, a doable alternative. The new pose joins the shared library for everyone; there are no private poses.

based_on.description: Optional: a library pose's handle, with or without the @ (from search_poses), to make a changed version of it; description then says what to change.

confirm.description: Optional: true to design a new pose even though design_pose found library poses that look like it.

description.description: The pose in words, head to toe: where the torso, head, arms, hands, legs and feet are, which way the body faces and what it touches, e.g. "sitting on a high stool, one foot on the rung, the other leg straight, hands on the front knee, looking over the left shoulder". With based_on: what to change. Up to 600 characters; no names of real people.
